item.title: Emami Q2 results: Profit rises nearly 2% at ₹145 cr, revenue up 36%
item.description: Homegrown FMCG major Emami Ltd on Thursday reported a marginal decline of 1.92 per cent in its Profit After Tax at Rs 145.50 crore for September quarter FY27, on account of elevated input costs and normalisation of the effective tax rate. The company had posted a PAT of Rs 148.35 crore in the July-September period a year ago, according to a regulatory filing from Kolkata-headquartered Emami. Revenue from operations was up 36.2 per cent year-on-year to Rs 1,087.65 crore in the September quarter under review. "Input costs remained elevated through the quarter. However, EBITDA grew by 25 per cent to Rs 222 crore and profit before tax grew 29 per cent to Rs 194 crore. Profit after tax was lower largely due to the normalisation of the effective tax rate following the phase-out of fiscal benefits," said Emami in its earnings statement. Total expenses were at Rs 865.33 crore, up 39.57 per cent in the September quarter of FY27. In the quarter, Emami's domestic business grew by 49 per cent
item.bs:keywords: Emami Q2 PAT up nearly 2 pc at Rs 145 cr, revenue up 36 pc to Rs 1,087 cr

item.description: British lender Barclays Bank on Thursday announced an additional investment of Rs 1,500 crore into its India operations. item.title: Tata Sons' Chandrasekaran meets Italian PM Meloni after Iveco acquisition
item.description: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran has met Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni at Palazzo Chigi in Rome, with the acquisition of Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco Group by Tata Motors featuring prominently in discussions amid growing strategic industrial and economic ties between the two countries. Sources said Chandrasekaran presented the Tata Group's strategy following the Indian conglomerate's acquisition of a controlling stake in Iveco Group, one of Italy's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, at the meeting held on Wednesday. The meeting came amid the increasing strategic economic and industrial collaboration between Italy and India.
